title: 環形雷射陀螺儀
subcategoryTitle: 光頻標準、慣性感測與干涉量測
subcategoryTitleEn: Optical frequency standards, inertial sensing and interferometric metrology
summary: 從主動環形雷射腔中兩道反向行進光束的頻率差出發，推導比例因子 4A/(λL)，理解背向散射鎖定為何需要機械抖動，再把 Zerodur 腔體、超低損耗鏡、對稱放電、路徑長度控制與 Allan 偏差誤差預算整合成可交付的慣性量測單元工程。
summaryEn: Start from the frequency difference between the two counter-propagating beams of an active ring-laser cavity, derive the 4A/(λL) scale factor, see why backscatter lock-in demands mechanical dither, then integrate the Zerodur block, ultralow-loss mirrors, symmetric discharge, path-length control and an Allan-deviation error budget into a deliverable inertial-measurement-unit engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子」與「鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor" and "Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「反向行進光束與拍頻」如何決定環形雷射陀螺儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency” determines the key performance of “Ring-laser gyroscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 環形雷射陀螺儀的環形腔內同時振盪順時針與逆時針兩道 HeNe 雷射模態；腔體不轉動時兩者頻率相同，腔體以角速率 Ω 繞法線旋轉時，順轉方向的有效周長變長、逆轉方向變短，兩模態的諧振頻率因此分裂。把兩道光在合光稜鏡上疊加，光電二極體看到的條紋移動速率就是拍頻 Δf，它與 Ω 成正比，比例常數只取決於幾何面積、周長與波長，所以它是一個不含運動件的角速率積分器：累計條紋數就是累計轉角。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反向行進光束與拍頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A ring-laser gyroscope sustains clockwise and counter-clockwise HeNe modes in one ring cavity. At rest they share one frequency; when the block rotates at rate Ω about its normal, the effective perimeter grows for the co-rotating beam and shrinks for the counter-rotating one, so the two resonances split. Recombined on a prism, the beams give photodiodes a fringe-motion rate equal to the beat frequency Δf, which is proportional to Ω with a constant set only by enclosed area, perimeter and wavelength. The device is therefore a rate integrator with no moving parts: counting fringes counts angle. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：比例因子 S = 4A/(λL)。
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「環形雷射陀螺儀像機械陀螺一樣靠角動量守恆感測旋轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ring-laser gyro senses rotation through angular-momentum conservation like a spinning-mass gyro." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「反向行進光束與拍頻」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子
knowledge.titleEn: Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor
knowledge.text: 環形雷射陀螺儀的環形腔內同時振盪順時針與逆時針兩道 HeNe 雷射模態；腔體不轉動時兩者頻率相同，腔體以角速率 Ω 繞法線旋轉時，順轉方向的有效周長變長、逆轉方向變短，兩模態的諧振頻率因此分裂。把兩道光在合光稜鏡上疊加，光電二極體看到的條紋移動速率就是拍頻 Δf，它與 Ω 成正比，比例常數只取決於幾何面積、周長與波長，所以它是一個不含運動件的角速率積分器：累計條紋數就是累計轉角。
knowledge.textEn: A ring-laser gyroscope sustains clockwise and counter-clockwise HeNe modes in one ring cavity. At rest they share one frequency; when the block rotates at rate Ω about its normal, the effective perimeter grows for the co-rotating beam and shrinks for the counter-rotating one, so the two resonances split.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：環形雷射陀螺儀像機械陀螺一樣靠角動量守恆感測旋轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ring-laser gyro senses rotation through angular-momentum conservation like a spinning-mass gyro. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor" is correct?
options: 環形雷射陀螺儀像機械陀螺一樣靠角動量守恆感測旋轉。
環形雷射陀螺儀的環形腔內同時振盪順時針與逆時針兩道 HeNe 雷射模態。
鎖定只是靈敏度降低，用更高增益的放大器就能讀出小角速率。
optionsEn: A ring-laser gyro senses rotation through angular-momentum conservation like a spinning-mass gyro.
A ring-laser gyroscope sustains clockwise and counter-clockwise HeNe modes in one ring cavity.
Lock-in merely lowers sensitivity, so a higher-gain amplifier can still read small rates.
quiz.explanation: 環形雷射陀螺儀的環形腔內同時振盪順時針與逆時針兩道 HeNe 雷射模態；腔體不轉動時兩者頻率相同，腔體以角速率 Ω 繞法線旋轉時，順轉方向的有效周長變長、逆轉方向變短，兩模態的諧振頻率因此分裂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A ring-laser gyroscope sustains clockwise and counter-clockwise HeNe modes in one ring cavity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反向行進光束與拍頻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：比例因子 S = 4A/(λL)。教學假設：正三角形環、邊長 0.10 m，則 L = 0.30 m、A = 4.33×10⁻³ m²，λ = 632.8 nm，S = 4×4.33×10⁻³/(632.8×10⁻⁹×0.30) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s)，即約 1592 Hz/(°/s)；一個條紋對應 1/S = 1.10×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 2.26 arcsec。地球自轉 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s 給出 6.65 Hz 的滿額拍頻，水平放置在北緯 25° 時只感測垂直分量 sin25° = 0.4226，拍頻 2.81 Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Scale factor S = 4A/(λL). Teaching assumption: an equilateral triangle of side 0.10 m gives L = 0.30 m and A = 4.33×10⁻³ m²; with λ = 632.8 nm, S = 4×4.33×10⁻³/(632.8×10⁻⁹×0.30) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s), about 1592 Hz/(°/s), and one fringe equals 1/S = 1.10×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 2.26 arcsec. Earth rotation at 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s gives a 6.65 Hz full beat; a horizontal ring at 25° N senses only the vertical component sin25° = 0.4226, so 2.81 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把陀螺儀固定在靜止平台並把輸入軸轉到垂直，以頻率計數器量拍頻並與 S·Ω_E·sinφ 比較；再把輸入軸轉到水平的東西向，拍頻應降到接近鎖定區內，證明感測的是沿法線的旋轉分量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fix the gyro on a static platform with its input axis vertical, measure the beat with a frequency counter and compare with S·Ω_E·sinφ; then turn the input axis horizontal east–west and confirm the beat falls toward the lock-in band, proving that only the component along the normal is sensed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 比例因子 S = 4A/(λL)。教學假設：正三角形環、邊長 0.10 m，則 L = 0.30 m、A = 4.33×10⁻³ m²，λ = 632.8 nm，S = 4×4.33×10⁻³/(632.8×10⁻⁹×0.30) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s)，即約 1592 Hz/(°/s)；一個條紋對應 1/S = 1.10×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 2.26 arcsec。地球自轉 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s 給出 6.65 Hz 的滿額拍頻，水平放置在北緯 25° 時只感測垂直分量 sin25° = 0.4226，拍頻 2.81 Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Scale factor S = 4A/(λL). Teaching assumption: an equilateral triangle of side 0.10 m gives L = 0.30 m and A = 4.33×10⁻³ m²; with λ = 632.8 nm, S = 4×4.33×10⁻³/(632.8×10⁻⁹×0.30) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s), about 1592 Hz/(°/s), and one fringe equals 1/S = 1.10×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 2.26 arcsec. Earth rotation at 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s gives a 6.65 Hz full beat; a horizontal ring at 25° N senses only the vertical component sin25° = 0.4226, so 2.81 Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor", which statement holds?
options: 只要氣體夠純，單一陽極的放電也不會產生零偏。
平均時間越長，陀螺儀的雜訊一定越小。
比例因子 S = 4A/(λL)。
optionsEn: With pure enough gas, a single-anode discharge introduces no bias.
Longer averaging always makes gyro noise smaller.
Scale factor S = 4A/(λL).
quiz.explanation: 比例因子 S = 4A/(λL)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Scale factor S = 4A/(λL). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「反向行進光束與拍頻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把陀螺儀固定在靜止平台並把輸入軸轉到垂直，以頻率計數器量拍頻並與 S·Ω_E·sinφ 比較；再把輸入軸轉到水平的東西向，拍頻應降到接近鎖定區內，證明感測的是沿法線的旋轉分量。用當地緯度與公開的地球自轉速率反算 S，偏差應在幾十 ppm 內，否則幾何或波長假設有錯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix the gyro on a static platform with its input axis vertical, measure the beat with a frequency counter and compare with S·Ω_E·sinφ; then turn the input axis horizontal east–west and confirm the beat falls toward the lock-in band, proving that only the component along the normal is sensed. Back out S from the local latitude and the public Earth rate; the discrepancy should be within tens of ppm or the geometry or wavelength assumption is wrong. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把腔長計算成實體周長而忽略氣體折射率與鏡面相位深度，S 會偏差數十 ppm；在一小時 10,000° 的累計轉動中，50 ppm 的比例因子誤差等於 0.5° 的航向誤差，遠超過導航級允收。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Computing cavity length as the physical perimeter while ignoring gas refractive index and mirror phase depth biases S by tens of ppm; over 10,000° accumulated in an hour, a 50 ppm scale-factor error equals 0.5° of heading error, far beyond navigation-grade acceptance.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把陀螺儀固定在靜止平台並把輸入軸轉到垂直，以頻率計數器量拍頻並與 S·Ω_E·sinφ 比較；再把輸入軸轉到水平的東西向，拍頻應降到接近鎖定區內，證明感測的是沿法線的旋轉分量。用當地緯度與公開的地球自轉速率反算 S，偏差應在幾十 ppm 內，否則幾何或波長假設有錯。

Back out S from the local latitude and the public Earth rate; the discrepancy should be within tens of ppm or the geometry or wavelength assumption is wrong.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor"?
options: 把陀螺儀固定在靜止平台並把輸入軸轉到垂直，以頻率計數器量拍頻並與 S·Ω_E·sinφ 比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
環形雷射陀螺儀沒有運動件，所以整機不需要振動測試。
optionsEn: Fix the gyro on a static platform with its input axis vertical, measure the beat with a frequency counter and compare with S·Ω_E·sinφ.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A ring-laser gyro has no moving parts, so the assembled unit needs no vibration testing.
quiz.explanation: 把陀螺儀固定在靜止平台並把輸入軸轉到垂直，以頻率計數器量拍頻並與 S·Ω_E·sinφ 比較；再把輸入軸轉到水平的東西向，拍頻應降到接近鎖定區內，證明感測的是沿法線的旋轉分量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fix the gyro on a static platform with its input axis vertical, measure the beat with a frequency counter and compare with S·Ω_E·sinφ; then turn the input axis horizontal east–west and confirm the beat falls toward the lock-in band, proving that only the component along the normal is sensed. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反向行進光束與拍頻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把腔長計算成實體周長而忽略氣體折射率與鏡面相位深度，S 會偏差數十 ppm；在一小時 10,000° 的累計轉動中，50 ppm 的比例因子誤差等於 0.5° 的航向誤差，遠超過導航級允收。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Computing cavity length as the physical perimeter while ignoring gas refractive index and mirror phase depth biases S by tens of ppm; over 10,000° accumulated in an hour, a 50 ppm scale-factor error equals 0.5° of heading error, far beyond navigation-grade acceptance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把兩道光在合光稜鏡上疊加，光電二極體看到的條紋移動速率就是拍頻 Δf，它與 Ω 成正比，比例常數只取決於幾何面積、周長與波長，所以它是一個不含運動件的角速率積分器：累計條紋數就是累計轉角。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The device is therefore a rate integrator with no moving parts: counting fringes counts angle.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「環形雷射陀螺儀像機械陀螺一樣靠角動量守恆感測旋轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ring-laser gyro senses rotation through angular-momentum conservation like a spinning-mass gyro." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把腔長計算成實體周長而忽略氣體折射率與鏡面相位深度，S 會偏差數十 ppm；在一小時 10,000° 的累計轉動中，50 ppm 的比例因子誤差等於 0.5° 的航向誤差，遠超過導航級允收。
knowledge.textEn: Computing cavity length as the physical perimeter while ignoring gas refractive index and mirror phase depth biases S by tens of ppm; over 10,000° accumulated in an hour, a 50 ppm scale-factor error equals 0.5° of heading error, far beyond navigation-grade acceptance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.explanationEn: Computing cavity length as the physical perimeter while ignoring gas refractive index and mirror phase depth biases S by tens of ppm; over 10,000° accumulated in an hour, a 50 ppm scale-factor error equals 0.5° of heading error, far beyond navigation-grade acceptance. steps.title: 鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「背向散射與抖動馬達」如何決定環形雷射陀螺儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backscatter and dither motor” determines the key performance of “Ring-laser gyroscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鏡面上奈米級的散射把一小部分順時針光耦合到逆時針模態，兩個振盪器因而互相牽引；當拍頻低於耦合強度時，兩模態鎖成同一頻率，陀螺儀對小角速率完全沒有輸出。這個死區由 Adler 鎖定方程 dψ/dt = Δω − ω_L·sinψ 描述，ω_L 正比於每圈的背向散射振幅 r_s 乘以自由光譜範圍 c/L。工程解法是讓整個腔體以數百赫茲作微小扭轉抖動，使瞬時角速率絕大部分時間遠高於鎖定門檻，只在每次過零時留下隨機相位誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背向散射與抖動馬達」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nanometre-scale scatter at the mirrors couples a little clockwise light into the counter-clockwise mode, and the two oscillators pull on each other; when the beat falls below the coupling strength the modes lock to one frequency and the gyro reads zero for small rates. The dead band follows the Adler equation dψ/dt = Δω − ω_L·sinψ, with ω_L proportional to the per-round-trip backscatter amplitude r_s times the free spectral range c/L. The engineering remedy twists the whole block at a few hundred hertz so that the instantaneous rate stays far above threshold almost all the time, leaving only a random phase error at each zero crossing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Backscatter and dither motor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鎖定拍頻 f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL)，換成角速率 Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lock-in beat f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL), or in rate Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鎖定只是靈敏度降低，用更高增益的放大器就能讀出小角速率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lock-in merely lowers sensitivity, so a higher-gain amplifier can still read small rates." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「背向散射與抖動馬達」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Backscatter and dither motor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動
knowledge.titleEn: Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither
knowledge.text: 鏡面上奈米級的散射把一小部分順時針光耦合到逆時針模態，兩個振盪器因而互相牽引；當拍頻低於耦合強度時，兩模態鎖成同一頻率，陀螺儀對小角速率完全沒有輸出。這個死區由 Adler 鎖定方程 dψ/dt = Δω − ω_L·sinψ 描述，ω_L 正比於每圈的背向散射振幅 r_s 乘以自由光譜範圍 c/L。
knowledge.textEn: Nanometre-scale scatter at the mirrors couples a little clockwise light into the counter-clockwise mode, and the two oscillators pull on each other; when the beat falls below the coupling strength the modes lock to one frequency and the gyro reads zero for small rates. The dead band follows the Adler equation dψ/dt = Δω − ω_L·sinψ, with ω_L proportional to the per-round-trip backscatter amplitude r_s times the free spectral range c/L.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鎖定只是靈敏度降低，用更高增益的放大器就能讀出小角速率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lock-in merely lowers sensitivity, so a higher-gain amplifier can still read small rates. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither" is correct?
options: 鎖定只是靈敏度降低，用更高增益的放大器就能讀出小角速率。
普通高反射雷射鏡（反射率 99.9%）就足以讓環形雷射起振。
鏡面上奈米級的散射把一小部分順時針光耦合到逆時針模態，兩個振盪器因而互相牽引；當拍頻低於耦合強度時，兩模態鎖成同一頻率，陀螺儀對小角速率完全沒有輸出。
optionsEn: Lock-in merely lowers sensitivity, so a higher-gain amplifier can still read small rates.
An ordinary 99.9% high-reflectivity laser mirror is enough to make a ring laser oscillate.
Nanometre-scale scatter at the mirrors couples a little clockwise light into the counter-clockwise mode, and the two oscillators pull on each other.
quiz.explanation: 鏡面上奈米級的散射把一小部分順時針光耦合到逆時針模態，兩個振盪器因而互相牽引；當拍頻低於耦合強度時，兩模態鎖成同一頻率，陀螺儀對小角速率完全沒有輸出。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Nanometre-scale scatter at the mirrors couples a little clockwise light into the counter-clockwise mode, and the two oscillators pull on each other; when the beat falls below the coupling strength the modes lock to one frequency and the gyro reads zero for small rates. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背向散射與抖動馬達」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backscatter and dither motor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鎖定拍頻 f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL)，換成角速率 Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA)。取 r_s = 1×10⁻⁶、L = 0.30 m：f_L ≈ 159 Hz，Ω_L ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s ≈ 360 °/h。抖動 400 Hz、峰值幅度 100 arcsec 時峰值角速率 Ω_d = 2π·400·4.85×10⁻⁴ ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s，死區時間占比約 (2/π)(Ω_L/Ω_d) ≈ 9×10⁻⁴；正弦抖動下殘餘角度隨機漫步的量級估計 ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lock-in beat f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL), or in rate Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA). With r_s = 1×10⁻⁶ and L = 0.30 m: f_L ≈ 159 Hz, Ω_L ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s ≈ 360 °/h. Dither at 400 Hz with 100 arcsec peak gives Ω_d = 2π·400·4.85×10⁻⁴ ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s, a dead-band time fraction of about (2/π)(Ω_L/Ω_d) ≈ 9×10⁻⁴, and an order-of-magnitude residual angle random walk ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：關閉抖動，把陀螺儀放在速率轉台上由零緩慢加速，記錄拍頻首次出現的輸入速率，就是鎖定門檻；再開啟抖動，用抖動拾取器訊號從輸出中剝除抖動分量，確認低速率輸出恢復線性，並以長時間靜態資料的 Allan 偏差斜率 −1/2 段估計 ARW，與模型比較數量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: With dither off, place the gyro on a rate table and ramp slowly from zero; the input rate at which a beat first appears is the lock-in threshold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鎖定拍頻 f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL)，換成角速率 Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA)。取 r_s = 1×10⁻⁶、L = 0.30 m：f_L ≈ 159 Hz，Ω_L ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s ≈ 360 °/h。抖動 400 Hz、峰值幅度 100 arcsec 時峰值角速率 Ω_d = 2π·400·4.85×10⁻⁴ ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s，死區時間占比約 (2/π)(Ω_L/Ω_d) ≈ 9×10⁻⁴；正弦抖動下殘餘角度隨機漫步的量級估計 ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h。
knowledge.textEn: Lock-in beat f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL), or in rate Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA). With r_s = 1×10⁻⁶ and L = 0.30 m: f_L ≈ 159 Hz, Ω_L ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s ≈ 360 °/h. Dither at 400 Hz with 100 arcsec peak gives Ω_d = 2π·400·4.85×10⁻⁴ ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s, a dead-band time fraction of about (2/π)(Ω_L/Ω_d) ≈ 9×10⁻⁴, and an order-of-magnitude residual angle random walk ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither", which statement holds?
options: 鎖定拍頻 f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL)，換成角速率 Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA)。
比例因子由幾何決定，所以一經設計就不需要校正。
環形雷射陀螺儀沒有運動件，所以整機不需要振動測試。
optionsEn: Lock-in beat f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL), or in rate Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA).
Scale factor is fixed by geometry, so a designed value needs no calibration.
A ring-laser gyro has no moving parts, so the assembled unit needs no vibration testing.
quiz.explanation: 鎖定拍頻 f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL)，換成角速率 Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Lock-in beat f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL), or in rate Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「背向散射與抖動馬達」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Backscatter and dither motor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 關閉抖動，把陀螺儀放在速率轉台上由零緩慢加速，記錄拍頻首次出現的輸入速率，就是鎖定門檻；再開啟抖動，用抖動拾取器訊號從輸出中剝除抖動分量，確認低速率輸出恢復線性，並以長時間靜態資料的 Allan 偏差斜率 −1/2 段估計 ARW，與模型比較數量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: With dither off, place the gyro on a rate table and ramp slowly from zero; the input rate at which a beat first appears is the lock-in threshold. Turn dither on, strip the dither component from the output using the dither pick-off signal, confirm that low-rate output is linear again, and estimate ARW from the slope −1/2 segment of a long static Allan deviation, comparing order of magnitude with the model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鏡面微粒污染或鍍膜老化使 r_s 上升一個數量級，鎖定門檻隨之上升十倍、ARW 同步惡化；若抖動振幅又因撓性彈簧疲勞下降，死區占比急升，靜態漂移與隨機漫步同時超出規格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Particle contamination or coating ageing that raises r_s by an order of magnitude raises the lock-in threshold tenfold and degrades ARW with it; if the dither amplitude also drops through flexure-spring fatigue, the dead-band fraction jumps and both static drift and random walk exceed specification.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 關閉抖動，把陀螺儀放在速率轉台上由零緩慢加速，記錄拍頻首次出現的輸入速率，就是鎖定門檻；再開啟抖動，用抖動拾取器訊號從輸出中剝除抖動分量，確認低速率輸出恢復線性，並以長時間靜態資料的 Allan 偏差斜率 −1/2 段估計 ARW，與模型比較數量級。
knowledge.textEn: With dither off, place the gyro on a rate table and ramp slowly from zero; the input rate at which a beat first appears is the lock-in threshold. Turn dither on, strip the dither component from the output using the dither pick-off signal, confirm that low-rate output is linear again, and estimate ARW from the slope −1/2 segment of a long static Allan deviation, comparing order of magnitude with the model.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
關閉抖動，把陀螺儀放在速率轉台上由零緩慢加速，記錄拍頻首次出現的輸入速率，就是鎖定門檻。
陀螺羅經的航向精度只取決於陀螺儀零偏，與對準時間無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
With dither off, place the gyro on a rate table and ramp slowly from zero; the input rate at which a beat first appears is the lock-in threshold.
Gyrocompass heading accuracy depends only on gyro bias and not on alignment time.
quiz.explanation: 關閉抖動，把陀螺儀放在速率轉台上由零緩慢加速，記錄拍頻首次出現的輸入速率，就是鎖定門檻；再開啟抖動，用抖動拾取器訊號從輸出中剝除抖動分量，確認低速率輸出恢復線性，並以長時間靜態資料的 Allan 偏差斜率 −1/2 段估計 ARW，與模型比較數量級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: With dither off, place the gyro on a rate table and ramp slowly from zero; the input rate at which a beat first appears is the lock-in threshold. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背向散射與抖動馬達」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Backscatter and dither motor” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鏡面微粒污染或鍍膜老化使 r_s 上升一個數量級，鎖定門檻隨之上升十倍、ARW 同步惡化；若抖動振幅又因撓性彈簧疲勞下降，死區占比急升，靜態漂移與隨機漫步同時超出規格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Particle contamination or coating ageing that raises r_s by an order of magnitude raises the lock-in threshold tenfold and degrades ARW with it; if the dither amplitude also drops through flexure-spring fatigue, the dead-band fraction jumps and both static drift and random walk exceed specification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工程解法是讓整個腔體以數百赫茲作微小扭轉抖動，使瞬時角速率絕大部分時間遠高於鎖定門檻，只在每次過零時留下隨機相位誤差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The engineering remedy twists the whole block at a few hundred hertz so that the instantaneous rate stays far above threshold almost all the time, leaving only a random phase error at each zero crossing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鎖定只是靈敏度降低，用更高增益的放大器就能讀出小角速率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lock-in merely lowers sensitivity, so a higher-gain amplifier can still read small rates." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鏡面微粒污染或鍍膜老化使 r_s 上升一個數量級，鎖定門檻隨之上升十倍、ARW 同步惡化；若抖動振幅又因撓性彈簧疲勞下降，死區占比急升，靜態漂移與隨機漫步同時超出規格。
knowledge.textEn: Particle contamination or coating ageing that raises r_s by an order of magnitude raises the lock-in threshold tenfold and degrades ARW with it; if the dither amplitude also drops through flexure-spring fatigue, the dead-band fraction jumps and both static drift and random walk exceed specification.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
普通高反射雷射鏡（反射率 99.9%）就足以讓環形雷射起振。
鏡面微粒污染或鍍膜老化使 r_s 上升一個數量級，鎖定門檻隨之上升十倍、ARW 同步惡化。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An ordinary 99.9% high-reflectivity laser mirror is enough to make a ring laser oscillate.
Particle contamination or coating ageing that raises r_s by an order of magnitude raises the lock-in threshold tenfold and degrades ARW with it.
quiz.explanation: 鏡面微粒污染或鍍膜老化使 r_s 上升一個數量級，鎖定門檻隨之上升十倍、ARW 同步惡化；若抖動振幅又因撓性彈簧疲勞下降，死區占比急升，靜態漂移與隨機漫步同時超出規格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Particle contamination or coating ageing that raises r_s by an order of magnitude raises the lock-in threshold tenfold and degrades ARW with it; if the dither amplitude also drops through flexure-spring fatigue, the dead-band fraction jumps and both static drift and random walk exceed specification. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
